definition: Group experience is the shared social and emotional experience of taking part in an activity with other people. In this context, it involves interpersonal interaction and shared enjoyment that can strengthen feelings of connection, acceptance, and social belonging.

reasons: The packet does not provide a definition or clear description of the term “group experience” as “the shared social and emotional experience of taking part in an activity with other people.” It only refers to “shared group experience” as part of the VR-based group dance approach, without defining the term.

The definition’s claim that this “strengthen[s] feelings of connection, acceptance, and social belonging” is partly unsupported. The packet reports improvements in “perceived social belonging” (measured with SOBI) and discusses social belonging as involving feeling accepted/valued/connected, but it does not explicitly link “group experience” (as defined) to “acceptance” specifically.

The definition makes broad generalization about “shared enjoyment” strengthening “feelings of connection, acceptance, and social belonging,” while the packet specifically supports social-psychological gains (social belonging) in the context of a particular VR-based group dance intervention, not the general psychological effects of “group experience” in all contexts.
